pr.title: Type-check the hooks module in the local gate
pr.head: c38d3b15332ab1c1c2786ad4055a467cfe088cd5

summary: Projector ships a Claude Code hooks module in hooks/: TypeScript that draws Projector's band above the prompt and reads the inbox. Claude Code compiles and runs it, but the validation gate never type-checked it. claude plugin validate . and claude plugin test . both pass code that tsc rejects, which is how the type error that #287 fixed reached main.
This change adds hooks/typecheck.sh to the local gate. The script runs the TypeScript compiler that site/ already installs, through a new root tsconfig.json that covers only hooks/.

The compiler needs Claude Code's own declarations: the claude-code module, its claude-code/testing kit, and the inputs of the built-in tools. Claude Code writes them to .claude-plugin/types/ when an interactive session loads the checkout with claude --plugin-dir ., and nothing else provides them. So the check runs only in the local gate, and the Check workflow in CI does not run it. A fresh checkout, including a review's scratch worktree, fails the step with a setup message until someone starts such a session there.

cards.title: Set up a checkout once
cards.html:
1. Run npm ci in site/, which installs tsc.
  2. Start claude --plugin-dir . from the repository root and quit at the prompt. Claude Code writes the declarations to .claude-plugin/types/, which Git ignores.
  3. Run hooks/typecheck.sh. Repeat step 2 after you update Claude Code.

cards.title: Review so far
cards.html:
• One Projector review, at c38d3b1, found the head clean, with no finding threads.
  • That review could not get engine-written declarations, so it ran the check against a copy rebuilt from the declarations Claude Code 2.1.296 bundles with its plugin-authoring skill.

groups.title: The type check and its configuration
groups.kicker: A gate script, the root tsconfig it compiles with, and the ignore rule for the declarations
intro: hooks/typecheck.sh checks two preconditions, then runs tsc -p . from the repository root. It exits 1 with a setup instruction when either the declarations or the compiler is missing, and otherwise exits with the compiler's status, 2 on a type error.

The root tsconfig.json extends the tsconfig.json Claude Code writes in .claude-plugin/types/. That file carries the compiler options a hooks module needs, such as JSX compiled to h, and makes the folder the type root. The root file only narrows include to hooks. It sits at the root because Claude Code writes its own root tsconfig.json into a plugin that has none, and a committed one stops that untracked file from appearing.

checks.text: The check catches the errors it exists for. With declarations rebuilt from Claude Code 2.1.296's bundled copy, the head exits 0. A deliberate error in hooks/parse.ts exits 2 with TS2322, and the hooks/ tree from 7e0a5e0 exits 2 with the one hooks/register.tsx(282,60) error that #287 fixed.

The root tsconfig.json does not change how Claude Code loads the plugin. With .claude-plugin/types/ removed, as in an installed copy, claude plugin test . passes all 78 tests. A root tsconfig.json with a bogus jsxFactory also passes them, so the engine does not read the file at load time.

files.note: The gate step: checks for the declarations and for tsc, then type-checks hooks/.

checks.text: The script tests only that .claude-plugin/types/tsconfig.json exists. Declarations written by an older Claude Code pass this test, which is why the documentation says to start a session again after an update.
Without .claude-plugin/types/, the script exits 1 and prints the three-line setup message, which a fresh scratch worktree reproduced.

files.note: Extends Claude Code's generated tsconfig.json and limits the program to hooks/.

checks.text: site/ keeps its own tsconfig.json, so npm run check in site/ still passes with this file at the root.

files.note: Ignores .claude-plugin/types/, which Claude Code writes into the checkout.

groups.title: Gate documentation
groups.kicker: Where contributors learn about the new step and its one-time setup
intro: Three documents list the gate, and each now lists hooks/typecheck.sh. AGENTS.md is the file agents follow, and CLAUDE.md is a symlink to it. docs/develop.md turns the old one-line npm ci reminder into two setup steps. docs/plugins.md adds the step to the checks a plugin author runs before publishing.

files.note: Adds the step to the gate and explains why CI cannot run it.
Two setup steps before the gate, and a note that the Check workflow cannot type-check hooks/.

checks.text: The claim that Projector loads only with gh-stack installed matches dependencies in .claude-plugin/plugin.json, and the plugins.md#install-for-claude-code anchor resolves.
